description: "A Description of Modern Birmingham" by Charles Pye is a historical account likely written in the early 19th century. This work serves as a detailed portrayal of Birmingham during a time of industrial growth, surveying its geography, public institutions, and social life through the author’s observations made during an excursion in 1818.
